not_met.lacks: Filling in Tests, the generator meets two answers on what the figure's rows hold. The template's note at architecture/template.md:186 gives a row to each deployment unit, and its skeleton has no place for a unit that has no row. The practice at architecture/best-practice.md:164, though, leaves out a unit whose every cell would be empty and says why under the table. A generator that fills only the template draws a row of empty cells, or drops the unit and doesn't say why. A developer who asks whether anything goes untested then can't tell whether someone left out a unit with no row on purpose. The other sections tell the generator what each slot holds, in what order, and when to leave it out.
